note: Suriname: an employer may not have a foreigner work without the Director of Labour's work permit, applied for by employer and worker (Wet Werkvergunning Vreemdelingen, 1981, as amended 2002). The Ministry's folder exempts, among others, a CARICOM skilled national (the csme list). No category for performers was found, so no days without the permit are modelled.
